summary: This is a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release of annual financial results for fiscal year 2025. The company reports a 39% revenue increase to $19.6 million and a net income turnaround of $1.9 million. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate action—is described. The filing is purely an earnings release with no deal terms, strategic review, or governance change. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation.
